MacBook Pro Luxury Combo – 20 Products in One Package

Discover an exciting collection of technology, smart accessories, fashion essentials and fragrances with the MacBook Pro Luxury Combo. This special package brings together a MacBook Pro and a variety of useful accessories and lifestyle products in one convenient offer.

💻 MacBook Pro: The main product in this combo, suitable for work, study, business and everyday productivity. Exact specifications depend on the included MacBook Pro model.

🌸 Luxury Perfumes: Includes five perfumes from mixed brands, giving you a varied fragrance collection for different occasions.

📱 Nokia 106: A classic mobile phone included for basic communication needs.

⌚ Fashion & Smart Watches: The package includes one Ladies Luxury Watch Set and three M59 Pro Max smartwatches, combining fashionable accessories with smart wearable options.

🎧 Audio Accessories: Enjoy the convenience of a Wireless Bluetooth Speaker, Wireless Sports Earphone N50 Pro and Modio Air B8 Earbuds for compatible audio devices.

🖱️ Computer Accessories: A computer mouse, mouse pad and electronic writing pad add useful accessories for everyday computing, note-taking and productivity.

🔌 Essential Accessories: The combo also includes a MacBook charger, power cable and laptop bag for added convenience when using and carrying your laptop.

🎁 One Exciting Combo: With 14 listed product categories, including five perfumes and three smartwatches, this package combines technology, accessories, fragrances and fashion essentials in one offer.

MacBook Pro Luxury Combo is a convenient choice for customers looking for a combination of computing equipment, mobile accessories, wearable devices and lifestyle products.

Note: The MacBook Pro model and specifications, perfume brands, accessory designs and product variants may vary depending on the actual combo. Please confirm the included items and compatibility before ordering.

product_detail.description:
Motorola Moto G34 5G

The Motorola Moto G34 5G is a versatile smartphone designed for everyday communication, entertainment and productivity. With 5G connectivity, a smooth 120Hz display and a capable Snapdragon processor, it offers practical features for daily smartphone use.

Its 6.5-inch IPS LCD display features a 120Hz refresh rate and 720 × 1600 resolution for smooth scrolling and comfortable viewing. The Qualcomm Snapdragon 695 5G processor supports everyday applications, browsing, multitasking and entertainment.

The phone is available with different memory configurations, including up to 8GB RAM and 256GB storage. The microSDXC card slot provides additional storage expansion, although it shares the SIM slot.

Capture everyday moments with the 50MP main rear camera and 2MP macro camera. The 16MP front camera is suitable for selfies and video calls, with both cameras supporting 1080p video recording at 30fps.

A 5000mAh battery with 18W wired charging helps support everyday use. Additional features include stereo speakers, Snapdragon Sound, a 3.5mm headphone jack, USB Type-C connectivity and a side-mounted fingerprint sensor.

The Motorola Moto G34 5G also features a water-repellent design and comes in attractive color options, including Charcoal Black, Ice Blue, Ocean Green and Vanilla Cream.

Motorola Moto G34 5G is a practical choice for users looking for 5G connectivity, a high-refresh-rate display, versatile cameras and a long-lasting battery for everyday activities.

Note: RAM, storage, operating system, SIM configuration, NFC availability, back material and weight may vary by model and region. Please confirm the selected variant before ordering.

product_detail.description:
Infinix SMART 20

The Infinix SMART 20 is designed for everyday smartphone users who need a large display, practical performance, useful connectivity and reliable battery capacity for daily activities.

Its 6.78-inch IPS LCD display features a smooth 120Hz refresh rate and up to 700 nits HBM brightness. The MediaTek Helio G81 Ultimate processor and 4GB RAM support everyday tasks such as browsing, messaging, social media and multimedia playback.

With 64GB or 128GB internal storage and a dedicated microSDXC card slot, you can store your essential apps, photos, videos and documents with additional expansion options.

Capture everyday moments with the 8MP autofocus rear camera and take selfies or make video calls using the 8MP front camera. Both cameras support video recording at the resolutions listed in the specifications.

The 5200mAh battery supports 15W wired charging and 5W reverse wired charging. Additional features include a side-mounted fingerprint sensor, dual Nano-SIM, NFC, infrared port, FM radio and a 3.5mm headphone jack.

Running Android 16 with XOS 16, the Infinix SMART 20 combines practical everyday features with a slim design, IP64 dust and splash resistance, and multiple color options.

Infinix SMART 20 is a practical option for users looking for an affordable everyday smartphone for communication, entertainment and daily productivity.

Note: Storage options, colors and specifications may vary by region and selected model.
